title: Questions 172-175 refer to the following online-message chain.
passage_1:
Grace Odum (9:31 A.M.)
Morning, everyone. I want a quick update before our busiest weeks of the summer start. Anything I ought to know about?

Bruno Ferrante (9:33 A.M.)
Everything is running well. You really should try the new touch pool we opened in the Reef Zone last weekend. It is wonderful.

Grace Odum (9:35 A.M.)
It’s on my list. But I want to go through the handling guidelines first so that I fully understand what the keepers tell visitors before I try it.

Bruno Ferrante (9:37 A.M.)
You will be impressed. According to the visitor comment cards I went through yesterday, our guests love getting that close to the animals. The pool is busy from opening to closing.

Grace Odum (9:40 A.M.)
That is very good news. And how is the rebuilt ticketing application coming along?

Bruno Ferrante (9:42 A.M.)
The screens are far simpler for our visitors to move through now. It has been tested from end to end and is completely ready to go live tomorrow morning.
